# OFFICIAL RETIREMENT ANNOUNCEMENT
**ZET | DIVISION**

After much consideration, I have decided to officially retire from ZET | DIVISION.

This community has been a memorable part of my journey. I've made memories, built connections, faced challenges, and experienced moments that I will always appreciate.

I want to thank every member, friend, and everyone who supported me throughout this journey. It wasn't an easy decision, but I believe it's time for me to move on and begin a new chapter.

I am proud to have been part of ZET | DIVISION.

**This isn't goodbye to the memories, only the end of my chapter.**

— Official Retirement
